posts.title: Lenny V3 - Refactoring and Vibecleaning
posts.description: Lenny v3 is the major refactor I've been working on, and the real challenge is just... focus. One of the interesting things about vibecoding is that everything seems possible. You can throw so many things out at once that it’s easy to get lost. The current focus is giving Lenny a lot of tools to understand data about me.
